parameters.query: WITH recent AS (SELECT stock_id, trading_date, close, high, low, volume FROM daily_prices WHERE trading_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '45 days'), pairs AS (SELECT a.stock_id AS id1, b.stock_id AS id2, COUNT(*)::int AS same_days FROM recent a JOIN recent b ON b.trading_date = a.trading_date AND b.stock_id > a.stock_id AND b.close = a.close AND b.high = a.high AND b.low = a.low AND b.volume = a.volume GROUP BY a.stock_id, b.stock_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15), flagged AS (SELECT s1.symbol AS sym1, s2.symbol AS sym2, s1.exchange, p.same_days FROM pairs p JOIN stocks s1 ON s1.id = p.id1 JOIN stocks s2 ON s2.id = p.id2 WHERE s1.active AND s2.active AND NOT s1.excluded AND NOT s2.excluded), ins AS (INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, error_message, payload) SELECT '19-egx-data-quality-audit', f.sym1 || '/' || f.sym2, 'Probable duplicate listing: identical OHLCV on ' || f.same_days || ' of the last ~30 sessions. Review and set stocks.excluded = TRUE (and active = FALSE) on the alias symbol.', jsonb_build_object('exchange', f.exchange, 'symbols', ARRAY[f.sym1, f.sym2], 'sameDays', f.same_days) FROM flagged f RETURNING 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins)::int AS ohlcv_pairs_flagged;

WITH isin_pairs AS (SELECT s1.id AS id1, s2.id AS id2, s1.symbol AS sym1, s2.symbol AS sym2, s1.exchange, s1.isin FROM stocks s1 JOIN stocks s2 ON s2.exchange = s1.exchange AND s2.isin = s1.isin AND s2.id > s1.id WHERE s1.active AND s2.active AND NOT s1.excluded AND NOT s2.excluded AND s1.isin IS NOT NULL AND s1.isin <> ''), enriched AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT MAX(trading_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE stock_id = p.id1) AS last1, (SELECT MAX(trading_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE stock_id = p.id2) AS last2 FROM isin_pairs p), stale AS (SELECT * FROM enriched WHERE LEAST(last1, last2) < CURRENT_DATE - 10), ins AS (INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, error_message, payload) SELECT '19-egx-data-quality-audit', s.sym1 || '/' || s.sym2, 'Shared ISIN ' || s.isin || ' and one side has no prices in 10+ days - likely a ticker rename leftover. Review and set stocks.excluded on the stale symbol.', jsonb_build_object('exchange', s.exchange, 'symbols', ARRAY[s.sym1, s.sym2], 'isin', s.isin, 'lastPriceDays', ARRAY[s.last1::text, s.last2::text]) FROM stale s RETURNING 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins)::int AS stale_isin_pairs_flagged;
